card.name: Commas between statin names in lists
card.fires_on: The comma or 'with' right after a statin name (simvastatin, atorvastatin, pravastatin, fluvastatin) or verapamil, in drug-interaction lists. It also fires on the '3' in CYP3A.

modes.label: Comma in statin list
modes.description: A comma follows a statin name inside a list of statins.
modes.example: such as simvastatin, atorvastatin<<,>> and lovastatin, and dosage adjustments

modes.label: With after verapamil
modes.description: The word 'with' follows verapamil before another drug being co-administered.
modes.example: Co-administration of multiple doses of 10 mg of verapamil<< with>> 80 mg simvastatin

modes.label: CYP3A enzyme name
modes.description: The digit 3 inside CYP3A in interaction tables.
modes.example: coadministration of strong CYP<<3>>A modulators on Zydelig.

card.plain: It marks the spot after a statin name in an interaction list, where another drug name comes next.
